value.rationale: A natural local reconstruction statistic is refined from class-count complexity to the complete multiplicity spectrum for a canonical infinite automatic word, at every dyadic length. The classification gives exact fibre sizes and identifies which endpoint/signature types are largest, using a structural Toeplitz/circular-cut decomposition. It is more than a finite table or renaming of the 4N factor-complexity theorem, while its domain limits are explicit.
